hints.title: Maximize Discount Value
hints.text: To minimize total purchase cost, the free candies should be as expensive as possible.

hints.title: Sort in Descending Order
hints.text: Sort candy prices descending so you pair the most expensive candies together.

hints.title: Skip Every Third Candy
hints.text: Buy the first two candies in each group of three and receive the third candy for free.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Random grouping might pair high cost candies with cheap ones, wasting the free candy discount.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy grouping from highest to lowest.
